content: Snapshot dating result: Review.md was written against a ~June 9-10 snapshot, NOT v0.0.1 (June 8) and not HEAD. Evidence: review describes Faithfulness.lean (#174, 06-09 15:31), SmtDemo (#184, 06-09 17:20), and the while layer (#163, 06-09 18:24) — all post-tag; but is ignorant of the Engine trait (#204, 06-11 00:02), LeanEngine (#240, 06-11 10:35), and cert engine attribution (#247, 06-11 12:49), which falsify its 'nothing in the cert flags the fragment' claim. Between her snapshot and HEAD the repo also ran the #248-#252 adversarial replay-soundness ratchet (5 critic-pinned bypass generations -> architectural root fix in ~5h), a live instance of the convergence-by-ratchet her §0 declares impossible.
